S.FORM: Somalia hya' ga cyux maki' tay 10 00 N, 49 00 E na Xweco syuw. kwara' kinghciyan niya' 637,657 sq km (maki' tay 44ginkgan kin wahci') (kinwhci' niya' ga 627,337 sq km , kinwhci' na lawsayan wsilung hya' ga 10,320 sq km) Kinkhmayan kwara' squliq hya' ga 10,817,354.
